BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

Fuess and Stearns, comps.  The Little Book of Society Verse.  1922.

By. Walter Learned

In Explanation

H
ER
 lips were so near
That—what else could I do?
You’ll be angry, I fear.
But her lips were so near—
Well, I can’t make it clear,
Or explain it to you.
But—her lips were so near
That—what else could I do?
